items.title_zh: 基于 MOABB 与扩展范式的 EEG 基准测试
items.title_en: EEG Benchmarks on MOABB and Additional Paradigms
bullets_zh: 在 MOABB BCI 基准上开展测试，并加入额外 EEG 范式。
适合比较非侵入式 EEG 解码与分类流程。
GitHub 项目于 2026-09-16 更新，支持可复现评估。
bullets_en: Provides benchmarking on MOABB BCI benchmarks with additional EEG paradigms.
Useful for comparing non-invasive EEG decoding and classification pipelines.
GitHub project updated on 2026-09-16, supporting reproducible evaluation.

items.title_en: MOABB fixes pyRiemann mean API compatibility for TRCA and TRCSP
bullets_zh: NeuroTechX MOABB提交#1180更新TRCA和TRCSP流程，以适配pyRiemann均值API变化。
该修复防止使用当前pyRiemann版本运行EEG BCI算法时出现基准测试失败。
发布于2026-09-14，使MOABB继续适用于非侵入式EEG评估流程。
bullets_en: NeuroTechX MOABB commit #1180 updates TRCA and TRCSP pipelines to match pyRiemann mean API changes.
The fix prevents benchmark failures when running EEG BCI algorithms with current pyRiemann versions.
Published 2026-09-14, it keeps MOABB usable for non-invasive EEG evaluation workflows.
items.brief: MOABB修复TRCA/TRCSP与pyRiemann API兼容，保障EEG基准可运行。
items.brief_en: MOABB fixes pyRiemann mean API compatibility for TRCA and TRCSP, keeping EEG BCI benchmarks runnable.
items.raw_excerpt: Fix pyRiemann mean API compatibility in TRCA and TRCSP (#1180)

items.title_zh: MOABB文档更新：在RPA示例中使用TLCenter
items.title_en: MOABB docs update uses TLCenter in RPA example
bullets_zh: 提交#1174更新MOABB文档，演示使用TLCenter变换器进行RPA。
它澄清了EEG BCI基准示例中的正确预处理用法。
发布于2026-09-08，帮助用户在MOABB中复现RPA流程。
bullets_en: Commit #1174 updates MOABB documentation to demonstrate RPA with the TLCenter transformer.
It clarifies correct preprocessing usage for EEG BCI benchmark examples.
Published 2026-09-08, it helps users reproduce RPA pipelines in MOABB.
items.brief: MOABB文档更新RPA示例，指导正确使用TLCenter预处理。
items.brief_en: MOABB documentation updates the RPA example to use TLCenter, clarifying EEG BCI preprocessing usage.

bullets_zh: 提交#1173修正MOABB文档中的公式显示。
该改动提升EEG BCI基准用户对算法描述的可读性。
发布于2026-09-05，是有用的文档维护更新。
bullets_en: Commit #1173 corrects equation display in MOABB documentation.
The change improves readability of algorithm descriptions for EEG BCI benchmark users.
Published 2026-09-05, it is a small but useful docs maintenance update.

items.title_en: MOABB fixes extra_runs behavior in RomaniBF2025ERP
bullets_zh: 提交#1175重构RomaniBF2025ERP，为epoch抽取添加结束缓冲。
它更新示例和裁剪处理，使extra_runs校准缓冲得到正确处理。
发布于2026-09-05，提升MOABB中ERP基准数据集处理的可靠性。
bullets_en: Commit #1175 refactors RomaniBF2025ERP to add an end buffer for epoch extraction.
It updates examples and crop handling so extra_runs calibration buffers are respected.
Published 2026-09-05, it improves reliability of ERP benchmark dataset processing in MOABB.
items.brief: MOABB修复extra_runs与ERP缓冲处理，提升数据集抽取可靠性。
items.brief_en: MOABB fixes extra_runs behavior and ERP epoch buffering, improving reliability of benchmark dataset processing.
items.raw_excerpt: Fixed behaviour of extra_runs (#1175) * Refactor RomaniBF2025ERP to add an end buffer to the epoch extraction Updated the RomaniBF2025ERP class. Modified example usage and adjusted the crop method to account for the calibration buffer. 发布于2026-08-31，是与贡献者相关的项目生命周期更新。
bullets_en: Commit #1172 marks MOABB's transition to the 1.8 development cycle.
It signals upcoming feature and maintenance work for the EEG BCI benchmark platform.
Published 2026-08-31, it is a project lifecycle update relevant to contributors.
items.brief: MOABB开启1.8开发周期，预示EEG基准平台后续更新。
items.brief_en: MOABB opens the 1.8 development cycle, signaling upcoming updates for the EEG BCI benchmark platform.

bullets_zh: 提交#1171准备MOABB 1.7.1版本发布。
它打包修复和更新，供非侵入式EEG BCI基准工具链用户使用。
发布于2026-08-31，提供稳定版前的近最终测试版本。
bullets_en: Commit #1171 prepares MOABB release 1.7.1.
It packages fixes and updates for users of the non-invasive EEG BCI benchmark toolkit.
Published 2026-08-31, it provides a near-final version for testing before stable release.
items.brief: MOABB预发布1.7.1，提供EEG基准工具链测试版本。

Signals upcoming feature and dataset updates for EEG/BCI benchmarking.
Provides a tracking point for contributors before the next release.

items.title_zh: MOABB 使数据集气泡图可复现
items.title_en: MOABB Makes Dataset Bubble Plots Reproducible
bullets_zh: MOABB 为六边形受试者布局增加显式 random_state 参数。
替换全局 NumPy 随机状态，使重复生成的气泡图保持一致。
提升 EEG/BCI 基准测试中数据集可视化的可复现性。
bullets_en: MOABB adds an explicit random_state parameter for hexagonal subject layouts.
Replaces global NumPy random state to make repeated bubble plots identical.
Improves reproducibility of dataset visualization in EEG/BCI benchmarking.
items.brief: MOABB 改进数据集气泡图可复现性，利于基准结果展示。
items.brief_en: MOABB makes dataset bubble plots reproducible, improving consistent visualization in EEG/BCI benchmarking.
items.raw_excerpt: ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible (#1168) ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible Replace the global NumPy random state used by the hexagonal subject layout with an explicit random_state parameter. Use a fixed default so repeated calls produce identical figures, while allowing integer seeds, NumPy Generators, and non-deterministic layouts through None. Add unit tests for seeded grid ge

items.title_zh: MOABB 在预取 NEMAR 前使用缓存数据
items.title_en: MOABB Uses Cached Data Before Prefetching NEMAR
bullets_zh: 当本地缓存存在时，MOABB 避免不必要的 NEMAR 预取。
在移除缓存后仍保留原有的 NEMAR 优先行为。
减少基准数据集工作流中的重复下载。
bullets_en: MOABB avoids unnecessary NEMAR prefetch when local cache exists.
Preserves original NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal.
Reduces redundant downloads for benchmark dataset workflows.
items.brief: MOABB 优化 NEMAR 数据预取，减少重复下载。
items.brief_en: MOABB uses cached data before prefetching NEMAR, reducing redundant downloads in EEG/BCI benchmark workflows.
items.raw_excerpt: Use cached data before prefetching NEMAR (#1169) * Avoid NEMAR prefetch for cached data * Preserve NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal
